name: CVRP X-n401-k29
description: Route identical vehicles of capacity 745 from one depot to serve the 400 customers of the CVRPLIB X-set instance X-n401-k29. Every customer is visited exactly once, the total demand on a route may not exceed the capacity, and every route starts and ends at the depot. The number of routes is free (the k in the instance name does not limit it). Minimise the total cost: the sum over all routes of the Euclidean distances between consecutive stops, the legs from and to the depot included, each distance rounded to the nearest integer.
contract: solve(inst) -> list of routes; a route is a list of customer ids from 1 to n in visiting order (the depot is node 0 and is not listed; empty routes are ignored). inst is a dict with n (number of customers), capacity, coords (array of shape (n + 1, 2), row 0 is the depot), demand (integer array of length n + 1, demand[0] = 0) and name. Score: the total cost, minimized.
notes: Best known solution 66154 (not proven optimal; CVRPLIB, checked 2026-11-11).
CVRPLIB X instance file X-n401-k29.vrp (galgos.inf.puc-rio.br/cvrplib, download/instance/id)
X-n401-k29 is an instance of the CVRPLIB X set with 400 customers and vehicle capacity 745, whose depot lies in the corner (0, 0) of a grid with integer coordinates from 0 to 1000.
The BKS is the cost of the solution file published by CVRPLIB on 2026-11-11; check for newer values before claiming a record.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Find a minimum-cost set of capacity-feasible vehicle routes from one depot that serves every customer of the CVRPLIB X instance X-n401-k29.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: The capacitated vehicle routing problem is the core model of distribution logistics (delivery, collection and service fleets). It is NP-hard; the X instances of 100 to 1,000 customers were generated to cover the attributes that make it hard, and the 39 that CVRPLIB lists as not proven optimal are open, so a cheaper set of routes is a new best known solution of an open standard instance.
